lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 국제 시민 센터예요. 처음 오셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. This is the International Citizens Center. Is this your first visit?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. gukje simin senteoyeyo. cheoeum osyeosseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, it's my first time. I'd like to know the rules.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 한국에 오신 지 얼마나 됐어요?
lines.beaver_en: Great. How long has it been since you came to Korea?
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. hanguge osin ji eolmana dwaesseoyo?
lines.learner: 한국에 온 지 1년 됐어요. 한국 생활이 재미있어요.
lines.en: It's been a year since I came to Korea. Life in Korea is fun.
lines.roman: hanguge on ji illyeon dwaesseoyo. hanguk saenghari jaemiisseoyo.

lines.beaver: 이 센터에는 세계 여러 나라 사람들이 와요.
lines.beaver_en: People from many countries around the world come to this center.
lines.beaver_roman: i senteoeneun segye yeoreo nara saramdeuri wayo.
lines.learner: 여러 나라 사람들이 모이네요. 국제 행사도 있어요?
lines.en: People from many countries gather here. Are there international events too?
lines.roman: yeoreo nara saramdeuri moineyo. gukje haengsado isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 매달 있어요. 그리고 저쪽은 출입 금지예요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, every month. And that area over there is off-limits.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, maedal isseoyo. geurigo jeojjogeun churip geumjiyeyo.
lines.learner: 아, 금지 구역에는 들어가면 안 되죠?
lines.en: Ah, I shouldn't go into restricted areas, right?
lines.roman: a, geumji guyeogeneun deureogamyeon an doejyo?

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 그리고 안에서 음식을 먹을 수 없어요.
lines.beaver_en: That's right. Also, you can't eat food inside.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. geurigo aneseo eumsigeul meogeul su eopseoyo.
lines.en: Okay, the rules are simple, so I understand them well.

lines.beaver: 이 동네에 사신 지는 얼마나 됐어요?
lines.beaver_en: How long have you lived in this neighborhood?
lines.beaver_roman: i dongnee sasin jineun eolmana dwaesseoyo?
lines.en: I've lived in this neighborhood for six months.
lines.roman: i dongnee san ji yukgaewol dwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then you must know the neighborhood rules well.
lines.en: Yes, the trash rules are the most important.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 불조심도 중요해요. 여기서 담배는 금지예요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Fire safety matters too. Smoking is prohibited here.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. buljosimdo jungyohaeyo. yeogiseo dambaeneun geumjiyeyo.
lines.learner: 작은 불이 큰불이 될 수 있죠. 조심할게요.
lines.en: A small fire can turn into a big one. I'll be careful.
lines.roman: jageun buri keunburi doel su itjyo. josimhalgeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 이 센터는 시민 누구나 쓸 수 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Good. Any citizen can use this center.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. i senteoneun simin nuguna sseul su isseoyo.
lines.learner: 한국어를 배운 지 오래 안 됐어요. 괜찮아요?
lines.en: I haven't been learning Korean for long. Is that okay?
lines.roman: hangugeoreul baeun ji orae an dwaesseoyo. gwaenchanayo?

lines.beaver: 그럼요. 외국 분들도 많이 오셔서 괜찮아요.
lines.beaver_en: Of course. Many foreigners come here too, so it's fine.
lines.beaver_roman: geureomyo. oeguk bundeuldo mani osyeoseo gwaenchanayo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll come again next week.
